segments.he: כֹּהֲנִים וּלְוִיִּם נֶהֱנִין לִי יִטְּלוּ כּוּ׳. אַלְמָא טוֹבַת הֲנָאָה אֵינָהּ מָמוֹן.
segments.en: § The mishna teaches that if one said: I will not let «priests and Levites benefit from me, they can take» the priestly and Levitical gifts from him against his will. The Gemara notes: «Apparently,» the «benefit of discretion» to give his teruma and tithes to the priest or Levite of his choice «is not» considered to have «monetary» value. The priests and Levites can take the gifts from the owner of the produce against his will, and the latter is not regarded as having conferred benefit upon them.
